name: generic-type-is-refused-not-mangled
why: Concordat does not spell generic type names. Any spelling would be an invention every SDK must reproduce character for character, and a Go or Python SDK has no CLR generic syntax to reproduce it from — the exact cross-language split ADR-019 exists to prevent. Refusing is honest and actionable; mangling would be silent and unrepeatable. Publish a named type instead.
